description: Cryptographically random generator backed by random_int / random_bytes. mode=number (min/max), string (length + charset: alpha/alphanumeric/numeric/lower/upper/hex/hex_upper/base58/base64url), word (English word list), picker (pick N from a list, with/without replacement), team (balanced round-robin team allocation), dice (NdM notation), coin, country (ISO list), uuid (v4 or v7).
name: random_gen
